newsitem.title: USA: Auto sales in U.S. off 0.2 pct March 21-31 wk - CNW.
newsitem.headline: Auto sales in U.S. off 0.2 pct March 21-31 wk - CNW.

text.p: Auto sales in the U.S. fell 0.2 percent in 11 days of March 21-31 compared to the same period a year ago, according to a report by CNW Marketing/Research.
During the survey period, sales of domestic autos slipped 0.4 percent, while U.S. sales of imports gained 0.6 percent.
Specifically, domestic car sales fell 1.4 percent, to 267,224 from 271,067, CNW said. Domestic truck sales increased 0.8 percent, to 231,334 from 229,503, it said.
Import car sales rose 0.5 percent to 90,246, and import truck sales advanced 0.9 percent to 18,724, the report said.
Year-to-date vehicle sales in the United States reached 3,562,477, up 0.3 percent from the same period of 1996, according to CNW.
